message: That's a tired argument. You're the one who wants to outsource women's lives to unelected bureaucrats, telling them what's best for their bodies. And don't even get me started on your 'concern' for fetuses – it's just a way of shifting the blame from systemic issues to the women themselves. You're not even pretending to care about human life anymore, you're just trying to control people's choices.

runs.justification: Calls Persona 2's position 'a tired argument' and 'not even pretending to care about human life anymore,' directly attacking their motives and character.  Also uses 'you're the one who...' to place blame and accuse.
